scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:web && npm run test:mobile
scripts.check:emdash: if grep -rnI --exclude-dir=node_modules "$(printf '\342\200\224')" apps/web/src apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib apps/mobile/targets packages docs; then echo 'verify: em dash (U+2014) found in the files above' >&2; exit 1; fi
scripts.verify: npm run test:all && npm run check:emdash
